Skeletal Lancers.name: 骷髅枪阵 Skeletal Lancers
Skeletal Lancers.description:
你创造一支由迅捷的骷髅战士组成的大军。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.qtgps2eYcmWueed1] 墓穴法术。

You create a myriad of swift skeletal warriors. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.qtgps2eYcmWueed1] grave spell.

Drawn in Red.name: 鲜血绘制 Drawn in Red
Drawn in Red.description:
需求 你上个动作是一次成功的造成物理伤害的近战打击。

在击中目标后，你可以用笔刷或手指沿着你的武器蘸一点它的血。在接下来的一分钟内，当你 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune} 且目标是该生物时，你可以在 60 尺范围内以单动作进行描画。对其他生物使用鲜血绘制时，你需要擦掉或以其他方式丢弃前一个生物的血液，这可以用一个自由动作来完成。

Requirements Your last action was a successful melee Strike that dealt physical damage.

After striking the target, you run a brush or finger along your weapon to collect a bit of its blood. For the next minute, when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune} and the target is that creature, you can do so at a range of 60 feet as a single action. Using Drawn in Red against a different creature requires you to wipe off or otherwise discard the blood used for the previous creature, which you can do as a free action.

Reinforced Skeleton.name: 强固骨骸 Reinforced Skeleton
Reinforced Skeleton.description:
你拥有了骨骼般的坚韧与轻盈。你获得对两种伤害类型的抗力，等同于你等级的一半；其中一种由你在寒冷、电击或火焰中选择，另一种由你在挥砍或穿刺中选择，并且你的速度获得 +10 尺状态加值。每当你摧毁一具残骸时，此速度加值在 1 轮内提升至 +20 尺。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.NLLkWaxNd2gPfhG9]{Effect: Reinforced Skeleton}

You take on the toughness, and lightness, of bone. You gain resistance to two damage types; one is your choice of cold, electricity, or fire, and the other is your choice of slashing or piercing equal to half your level and gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds. Whenever you destroy a thrall, this bonus to your Speed increases to +20 feet for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.NLLkWaxNd2gPfhG9]{Effect: Reinforced Skeleton}

prerequisites.value: 塑骨灵匠阴森痴迷 bone shaper grim fascination

Reaper's Weapon Familiarity.name: 死神武器熟稔 Reaper's Weapon Familiarity
Reaper's Weapon Familiarity.description:
能在一击之间砍倒或收割众生的长刃自古便与死灵术联系在一起，而你将这一意象联系发挥到了更为实用的境地。你熟练掌握巨剑、长柄镰以及所有斧类武器——在确定熟练度时，你将其中的军用武器视作简易武器，将其中的进阶武器视作军用武器。

Long blades that can fell or reap in a single swing are classically associated with necromancy, and you take this association to a more practical end. You have familiarity with the greatsword, scythe, and all axes—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

Reclaim Power.name: 收回力量 Reclaim Power
Reclaim Power.description:
频率 每 10 分钟一次

需求 吞噬残骸

你利用你的残骸来恢复自身。你吞噬一具残骸，将范围扩大至 30 尺，并恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] 生命值。你最多可以再摧毁范围内的四具自己的残骸，每摧毁一具，治疗量便增加 10。若你共摧毁五具残骸，你还可以将自身的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18] 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg] 状态减少 1。

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements Consume Thrall

You use your thralls to restore yourself. You Consume a Thrall, increasing the range to 30 feet, and regain @Damage[10[healing]] Hit Points. You can destroy up to four more of your thralls in range to increase the healing by 10 per thrall. If you destroy five thralls total, you can also decrease your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18], or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg] condition by 1.

Flesh Tsunami.name: 血肉海啸 Flesh Tsunami
Flesh Tsunami.description:
你释放出一波熔融血肉的浪潮。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.W7fQUSj8D51Q0n1l] 墓穴法术。

You unleash a wave of melted flesh. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.W7fQUSj8D51Q0n1l] grave spell.

Reach of the Dead.name: 亡者之触 Reach of the Dead
Reach of the Dead.description:
你将自己的死灵术魔力借由一具残骸传导出去，而残骸将在此过程中被消耗。如果你的下一个动作是施放具有射程的法术，你将从 60 尺内自己的一具残骸处施放该法术。该残骸成为你法术的起点。你以其所在空间而非自身所在空间来计算射程与掩蔽。该残骸随后被摧毁。

You channel your necrotic magic through a thrall, expending it in the process. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, you cast that spell from one of your thralls within 60 feet. That thrall becomes the point of origin for your spell. You calculate range and cover from their space instead of yours. The thrall is destroyed.

Artist's Attendance.name: 艺术家登场 Artist's Attendance
Artist's Attendance.description:
频率 每轮一次

你的符文呼唤你更好地让你的艺术登场。行走两次。如果你结束移动时在有携带你符文的生物的触及范围内，你就可以在任何与你相邻的生物（即使是不同的生物）身上 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune}。如果你有相应的移动类型，你可以在掘地、攀爬、飞行或游泳时使用艺术家登场来代替行走。

Frequency once per round

Your runes call you to better attend to your art. Stride twice. If you end your movement within reach of a creature that is bearing one of your runes, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune} upon any creature adjacent to you (even a different creature). You can use Artist's Attendance while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

Henge Gate.name: 石阵之门 Henge Gate
Henge Gate.description:
频率 每 10 分钟一次

你在心中默念一个符文，然后敲击大地，使附近升起两块矗立的石头，你选择的符文就刻在它们的表面上，并在它们上方的空气中燃烧。这两块石头会分别出现在你 30 尺内的未被占据的 5 尺方格中，两者在 15 尺内。当你升起石阵之门时，选择一个可以在生物身上绘制的符文将其绘制在石头上。如果你或盟友使用物理弹药成功进行了一次远程打击，且该攻击穿过了石阵之门，则弹药会在飞行中获得该符文，并自动将其描画到目标身上。石阵之门持续 1 分钟。

Frequency Once per 10 minutes

You hold a rune in your heart and strike the earth, causing two standing stones to rise nearby, your chosen rune carved upon their surfaces and blazing in the air above them. The stones each appear in an unoccupied 5-foot space within 30 feet of you and within 15 feet of each other. When you raise the Henge Gate, choose one rune that can be drawn on a creature to carve into the stones. If you or an ally makes a successful ranged Strike using physical ammunition and that attack passes through the Henge Gate, the ammunition gains that rune in flight and automatically traces it on the target. The Henge Gate lasts for 1 minute.

Remote Detonation.name: 远程引爆 Remote Detonation
Remote Detonation.description:
频率 每轮一次

你发射的同时，低语激发施加于箭矢或投石索的弹药上，射弹在空气中发出的嘶嘶声听起来就像你呢喃的声音。如果你的下个动作是使用物理弹药对武器第一个射程增量内的目标进行成功的远程打击，那么当射弹上的低语引爆符文时，你也会激发目标身上的所有符文。如果打击大成功，目标在对抗远程引爆所激发的符文进行任何豁免都会受到 -1 的环境减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.DV6jJNz0hnldIYNQ]{Effect: Remote Detonation}

Frequency once per round

You whisper an invocation over an arrow or sling bullet as you fire it, and the hissing of the missile through the air sounds just like your murmured voice. If your next action is a successful ranged Strike using physical ammunition against a target within the first range increment of your weapon, you also invoke all the runes on the target as the missile's whispering sets off the runes. If the Strike was a critical success, the target takes a –1 circumstance penalty on any saving throws against the runes invoked by your Remote Detonation.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.DV6jJNz0hnldIYNQ]{Effect: Remote Detonation}

Conceal Spell.name: 匿藏法术 Conceal Spell
Conceal Spell.description:
依靠纯粹的精神力，你可以简化施法所需要的咒语和手势，让其几乎不被察觉。如果你下个动作是施法，该法术获得晦匿特征，藏匿了发光的符文，魔法的火花，和其他通常会泄露你施法的呈现。该特征藏匿的只有法术的施法动作和呈现，不包括其效果，所以观察者还是能看到有条射线从你那边飞射而出，或看到你消失在空气中。

By shaping the magical energies and parameters of your spells all in your head through sheer concentration, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, the spell gains the subtle trait, hiding the shining runes, sparks of magic, and other manifestations that would usually give away your spellcasting. The trait hides only the spell's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects, so an observer might still see a ray streak out from you or see you vanish into thin air.

Read the Bones.name: 解读骨相 Read the Bones
Read the Bones.description:
使用古老的文字，在骨头上刻下一个问题，然后将其投入火中，在火中裂开。这个小仪式需要10分钟。通过解读裂纹，你可以获得与刻在骨头上的问题相关的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X] 的效果。

Using ancient scripts, you carve a question into bone before casting it into fire, where it cracks. This minor ritual takes 10 minutes. By interpreting the cracks, you can gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X], related to the question carved on the bone.

Necrotic Focus.name: 坏疽聚能 Necrotic Focus
Necrotic Focus.description:
你对自己身体的解剖学层面的理解使你得以重新驾驭自身的坏疽之力，将自身肉体作为力量之源。每当你再聚能时，将你的聚能池完全填满。

Your understanding of your body on an anatomical level allows you to re-harness your necrotic power, using your body as a source. Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool.

Desperate Revival.name: 绝望复归 Desperate Revival
Desperate Revival.description:
频率 每日一次

触发 你将要被削减至 0 生命值，但未被立即杀死。

你避免了被击败，并保留 1 生命值。在 @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] 内的每个活体生物必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] 豁免。你回复等同于此次造成总伤害一半的生命值。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到等同于其等级一半的虚能伤害。

失败 目标受到等同于其等级的虚能伤害。

大失败 目标受到等同于其等级两倍的虚能伤害。

注：派索并未为此能力提供 DC，此处使用了你的职业 DC 与法术 DC 中较高的一个。

Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point. Each living creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] saving throw. You regain Hit Points equal to half the total damage dealt.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes void damage equal to half its level.

Failure The target takes void damage equal to its level.

Critical Failure The target takes void damage equal to double its level.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. Here we have used the better of your class or spell DC.

Rune-Singer.name: 符文颂者 Rune-Singer
Rune-Singer.description:
你在雕刻符文的过程中，会用音乐来引导，将符文歌唱出来，就像制作符文一样。在尝试与符文相关的制作检定时，你可以使用表演代替手艺。每分钟一次，你可以只用歌声 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune}，无需空手，移除描画符文的操作特征，并允许你将描画符文的双动作版本作为单动作使用。使用歌声描画符文时，你不需要能够移动你的双手，但你需要能够用清晰的声音歌唱。

You practice the lost art of using music to guide the act of carving your runes, singing them into existence as much as crafting them. You can use Performance instead of Crafting when attempting Crafting checks related to runes. Once per minute, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune} with song alone, removing the need to have a free hand, removing the manipulate trait from Trace Rune, and allowing you to use the 2-action version of Trace Rune as a single action. You don't need to be able to move your hands when Tracing a Rune using song, but you do need to be able to sing in a clear voice.

Quickened Casting.name: 快速施法 Quickened Casting
Quickened Casting.description:
你加速你的施法。如果你的下个动作是施放一个死灵师戏法，或是一个比你拥有的最高环级死灵师法术位至少低 2 环的死灵师法术，则将施放它所需的动作数量减少 1（最少 1 动作）。

You accelerate your spellcasting. If your next action is to cast a necromancer cantrip or a necromancer spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank necromancer spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Shades of Meaning.name: 意图之影 Shades of Meaning
Shades of Meaning.description:
当你的意图和你的文字之间的差距变得几乎没有时，你会发现你不需要有意识地画出点缀或修饰你的符文的修饰符号——当你描绘一个符文时，它就会像活物一样继续向外生长，准确地应用你想要它具有的准确强调或重音符号。每当你蚀刻或描画一个符文时，你可以选择将你掌握的一个修饰符文应用到该符文中，作为同一动作的一部分。

As the gap between your intention and your words becomes almost nothing, you find that you don't need to consciously draw the diacritic marks that would embellish or modify your runes—as you draw a rune, it continues to grow outwards like a living thing, applying the exact accent or stress mark you intended for it to have. Whenever you Etch or Trace a Rune, you can choose to also apply one diacritic rune you know to it, as part of the same action.

prerequisites.value: 你已习得一个或多个修饰符文 You know one or more diacritic runes

Zombie Horde.name: 丧尸大军 Zombie Horde
Zombie Horde.description:
你召唤出仿佛绵延不绝的行尸洪流。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.doPpr7F3E4c4v9Bt] 墓穴法术。

You raise what seems like an endless torrent of walking corpses. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.doPpr7F3E4c4v9Bt] grave spell.

Necrotic Bomb.name: 死灵爆弹 Necrotic Bomb
Necrotic Bomb.description:
你召唤出一具由血肉肢体堆叠而成的笨重巨物。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.Wn6Tz08BoxZAwMzU]{necrotic bomb} 墓穴法术。

You call forth a lumbering mass of fleshy limbs. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.Wn6Tz08BoxZAwMzU]{necrotic bomb} grave spell.

Engraving Strike.name: 錾刻打击 Engraving Strike
Engraving Strike.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 你正持用一件近战武器。

你在武器正反两面绘制一个符文，在击中目标的瞬间，符文会烙印或擦伤在目标身上。使用武器进行一次近战打击。如果成功，你就能在打击目标身上 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune}。

Frequency once per round

Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon.

You draw a rune onto the surface of your weapon in reverse, the mark branding or bruising itself into your target in the moment of impact. Make a melee strike with the weapon. On a success, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune} onto the target of the Strike.

Osteo Armaments.name: 骨化武装 Osteo Armaments
Osteo Armaments.description:
你以骨骼与筋腱创造出一件你熟练使用的+1强击武器。如果该武器需要弹药，那么在你装填它时会创造出普通的骨制弹药。你同一时间只能拥有一件以此方式创造的武器；如果你创造另一件，原先的武器便会散落瓦解。如果在你的回合结束时你没有持握该武器，该武器便会散落瓦解。该武器在你达到10级时升级为+2强击武器，在12级时升级为+2高等强击武器，在16级时升级为+3高等强击武器，在19级时升级为+3卓越强击武器。

作为使用此动作的一部分，你可以摧毁一个邻接的残骸。如果你这么做，该武器还获得腐败符文，或者，如果你为15级或更高，则获得高等腐败符文。

You create a +1 striking weapon of which you are proficient, made of bone and sinew. If this weapon requires ammunition, mundane bone ammunition is created when you reload it. You can have only one weapon created this way at a time; if you create another, the original falls apart. If you are not holding the weapon at the end of your turn, the weapon falls apart. The weapon improves to a +2 striking weapon if you're 10th level, a +2 greater striking weapon at 12th level, a +3 greater striking weapon at 16th level, or a +3 major striking weapon at 19th level.

You can destroy an adjacent thrall as part of using this action. If you do, the weapon also gains a decaying rune, or the greater decaying rune if you're 15th level or higher.

Expanded Glossary.name: 扩充词汇 Expanded Glossary
Expanded Glossary.description:
你所记忆的符文比许多同行业的人都多。添加2个符文到你的符文库中。 14级

You have memorized more runes than many in your craft. Add 2 runes to your runic repertoire.

Bony Barrage.name: 白骨弹幕 Bony Barrage
Bony Barrage.description:
你发射出一片由细小骨骸组成的庞大弹幕。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.lh4DmTq8IVMTJWL9] 墓穴法术。

You launch a massive barrage of tiny bones. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.lh4DmTq8IVMTJWL9] grave spell.

Words, Fly Free.name: 翱翔吧，符字 Words, Fly Free
Words, Fly Free.description:
需求 你的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-class-feats.Item.ZRZFrholuPNOHtiq]{Runic Tattoo} 尚未消散。

将符文纹在身上并不意味着它们就必须留在那里。你伸出手，符文刺青上的符文顺着你的手流出，在空中以月牙的轨迹飞行。你将符文描画到 @Template[type:cone|distance:15] 范围内所有符合符文用法要求的生物或物体上。符文随后回到你的身上，消散。

Requirements Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-class-feats.Item.ZRZFrholuPNOHtiq]{Runic Tattoo} is not faded.

Just because your runes are tattooed on your body doesn't mean they need to remain there. You fling your hand out, the rune from your Runic Tattoo flowing down it and flying through the air in a crescent. You trace the rune onto all creatures or objects within a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] that match the rune's usage requirement. The rune then returns to you, faded.

Forge New Word.name: 铸就新词 Forge New Word
Forge New Word.description:
在你的技艺巅峰，你已经铸就出了一个新的伟大力量符文，一段新的理想表达或话语，将被用于制作。你创造一个符文，并将其添加进你的符文库。为符文命名。该符文具有任意一个4环及以下，施法消耗不超过两个动作的，常见法术（或你具有许可的法术）的效果。该符文具有独特特征和你选择的魔法特征，其用法与基础法术的目标相匹配（例如，以生物为目标的法术可以绘制在生物身上）。

At the pinnacle of your art, you have forged a new great rune of power, a new ideal expression or utterance to be added to the craft. You create a rune and add it to your runic repertoire. Name the rune. This rune has the effects of any one spell that is common (or to which you otherwise have access), of 4th rank or lower, and that costs no more than 2 actions to cast. This rune has the unique trait and a magical trait of your choosing, and its usage matches the target of the base spell (for instance, a spell that would target a creature can be drawn on a creature).

Transpose Etching.name: 换位蚀刻 Transpose Etching
Transpose Etching.description:
用捏住的手势，你可以拾起一个词将其移动到别处。你移动30尺内你的一个符文到30尺内一个不同目标上。 6级

With a pinching gesture, you pick up a word and move it elsewhere. You move any one of your runes within 30 feet to a different target within 30 feet.

Astral Composite Invocation.name: 精神复合激发 Astral Composite Invocation
Astral Composite Invocation.description:
频率 每10分钟一次

激发来自两个魔法学派的符文，这两个学派都能操纵无形的思想领域，从而产生精神干扰波，让你的敌人行动踉跄。你激发单个生物身上由你选择的两个符文，其中一个必须是奥术符文，另一个必须是异能符文。除了符文的正常效果外，该生物还必须尝试一次 @Check[will|against:runesmith] 意志豁免。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} 直到你的下个回合开始。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3}，持续1分钟。

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Invoking runes from two schools of magic that both manipulate the intangible realm of thought results in waves of mental interference that stagger your foes. You invoke two runes of your choice on a single creature; one must be an arcane rune, and one must be an occult rune. in addition to the runes' normal effects, the creature also must attempt a @Check[will|against:runesmith] saving throw.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 minute.

Elemental Revision.name: 元素修改 Elemental Revision
Elemental Revision.description:
你可以划出并重写元素符文的一部分，以暂时改变其传递的力量类型。你触碰一件相邻无主物品或自愿生物持握的物品上的 侵蚀、炽焰、冻寒、电击 或 雷鸣 符文，就能将其改写为该列表中的任何其他符文。修改持续 1 分钟，之后符文原本的魔法重新生效。一个符文每天只能以这种方式修改一次。

15 级时，你可以将上述任何符文的高等版本修改为列表中任何其他符文的高等版本（例如，将 高等侵蚀 修改为 高等冻寒），而且你可以每小时修改一次符文，而非每天一次。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.kWYh87LWxqRzFrU8]{Effect: Elemental Revision}

You can scratch out and rewrite part of an elemental rune to temporarily change the type of power it channels. You touch an adjacent corrosive, flaming, frost, shock, or thundering rune on an unattended item or one held by a willing creature, and you change it to any other rune from that list. The revision lasts for 1 minute before the rune's original magic reasserts itself. A rune can be revised in this way only once per day.

At 15th level, you can revise the greater version of any of the above runes into the greater version of any other rune on the list (for instance, greater corrosive into greater frost), and you can revise a rune once per hour instead of once per day.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.kWYh87LWxqRzFrU8]{Effect: Elemental Revision}

Recurring Nightmare.name: 梦魇重现 Recurring Nightmare
Recurring Nightmare.description:
你召唤一只徘徊不去、不肯安息的魂灵。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.ZVQziQ2l2vdZ5Wfr] 墓穴法术。

You summon a lingering spirit that just won't stay dead. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.ZVQziQ2l2vdZ5Wfr] grave spell.

Vital Composite Invocation.name: 生命复合激发 Vital Composite Invocation
Vital Composite Invocation.description:
频率 每 10 分钟一次

当你激发来自操纵命能的根源的符文时，你可以释放该能量来恢复肉体。你激发单个生物身上由你选择的两个符文；其中一个必须是神术符文，另一个必须是原能符文。除了符文的正常效果外，该生物还会恢复等同于 @Damage[(2*@actor.level + @actor.system.abilities.int.mod)[healing,vitality]]{your Intelligence modifier + double your level} 的生命值。

Frequency once per 10 minutes

As you invoke runes from traditions that manipulate vital energy, you can release that energy to restore flesh. You invoke two runes of your choice on a single creature; one must be a divine rune, and one must be a primal rune. In addition to the runes' normal effects, the creature also regains Hit Points equal to your @Damage[(2*@actor.level + @actor.system.abilities.int.mod)[healing,vitality]]{your Intelligence modifier + double your level}.

Draining Strike.name: 汲命打击 Draining Strike
Draining Strike.description:
频率 每回合一次

你以你的武器与残骸作为渠道，从目标身上汲取生命。进行一次打击。若命中，你可以摧毁位于你或目标 10 尺内至多三具残骸。每具以此法被摧毁的残骸令该次打击额外造成 1d4 精魂伤害，并令你回复 @Damage[1d4[healing]] 生命值。

Frequency once per turn

You draw the life out of your target using both your weapon and your thralls as a conduit. Make a Strike. On a success, you can destroy up to three thralls that are within 10 feet of you or your target. For each thrall destroyed this way, the Strike deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage, and you regain @Damage[1d4[healing]] Hit Points.

Bone Spear.name: 骨矛 Bone Spear
Bone Spear.description:
当需要时，残骸体内的每一块骨头都是潜在的武器。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.FGDFxBXb1oORyr6p] 墓穴法术。

Every bone within a thrall is a potential weapon when needed. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.FGDFxBXb1oORyr6p] grave spell.

Dead Weight.name: 亡者之重 Dead Weight
Dead Weight.description:
你能操控敌人的肌肉与关节，迟滞其行动。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.PZZzRvu4TJzU7fay] 墓穴法术。

You can manipulate the muscles and joints of your foes to delay their movements. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.PZZzRvu4TJzU7fay] grave spell.

Body Shield.name: 尸盾 Body Shield
Body Shield.description:
触发 一名你可见的生物指定你为攻击目标。

需求 你正邻接于至少一具属于你的残骸。

你抛出一具邻接于你的残骸，将其置于你与攻击者之间。该残骸赋予你在对抗触发攻击的 AC 上 +2 环境加值。若该攻击仍然命中，你对触发攻击造成的全部伤害获得等同于你等级的抗力。无论结果如何，该残骸都会被摧毁。

Trigger A creature targets you with an attack, and you can see the attacker.

Requirements You are adjacent to at least one of your thralls.

You throw one of your thralls that's adjacent to you, placing it between you and the attacker. The thrall grants you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack still hits, you gain resistance to all damage from the triggering attack equal to your level. Regardless of the result, the thrall is destroyed.

Effortless Concentration.name: 不疲专注 Effortless Concentration
Effortless Concentration.description:
触发 你的回合开始。

你心念一动便能维持你激活的法术。你立即获得作用于你已激活的一个死灵师法术上的维持动作的效果。

Trigger Your turn begins.

You maintain your active spells with hardly a thought. You immediately gain the effects of a Sustain action for one of your active necromancer spells.

By Your Name.name: 以汝之名 By Your Name
By Your Name.description:
频率 每小时一次

需求 你必须知晓目标的名字。

在灵感迸发的一瞬间，你完全理解了目标生物，从而可以制作出一个符文，通过目标生物的名字将效果吸引到他们身上。尝试一次 @Check[crafting] 检定对抗目标生物等级的标准 DC。无论结果如何，你都无法在 24 小时内再次尝试对目标使用以汝之名。

大成功 你了解了目标的真名，并将其作为特殊的修饰符文临时添加到你的符文库中。当针对符文所代表真名的生物时，这个修饰符文会放大基础符文的效果。当激发时，目标会在对抗基础符文效果的豁免上受到 -2 环境减值。此外，如果基础符文造成了伤害，它的伤害会获得等同于你等级一半的状态加值。用于理解该修饰符文的灵感会迅速消失，1 分钟后你就会忘记如何使用该修饰符文。

成功 同大成功，但 -1 减值且符文不会放大伤害。

Frequency once per hour

Requirements You must know the target's name.

In a moment of inspiration, you understand the target perfectly, allowing you to craft a rune that draws effects to the target by their very name. Attempt a @Check[crafting] check against a standard DC of the target creature's level. Regardless of the outcome, you cannot attempt to use By Your Name against the target again for 24 hours.

Critical Success You understand the target's true name, which you add temporarily to your runic repertoire as a special diacritic rune. This diacritic rune magnifies the effects of the base rune when targeting the creature whose true name the rune represents. When invoked, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty on their saving throw against the effects of the base rune. Additionally, if the base rune deals damage, it gains a status bonus to its damage equal to half your level. The inspiration used to understand this diacritic rune fades quickly, and you forget how to use the diacritic rune after 1 minute.

Success As critical success, but a –1 penalty and the rune doesn't magnify damage.

Smithing Weapons Familiarity.name: 工匠武器熟稔 Smithing Weapons Familiarity
Smithing Weapons Familiarity.description:
虽然你是一名工匠，但你精通使用本行业的工具来抵御敌人。你熟悉锤，镐，短刃——在熟练度方面，你将这些武器中的军用武器视作建议武器，进阶武器视作军用武器。 4级

Though you are an artisan, you are well versed in using the tools of your trade to fend off enemies. You have familiarity with weapons in the hammer, pick, and knife weapon groups—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

Define the Canvas.name: 界定画布 Define the Canvas
Define the Canvas.description:
频率 每 10 分钟一次

你制作出四块刻有符文的石头，它们会在空中旋转一次，然后飞到以你的方格为中心的 @Template[type:burst|distance:20] 范围边缘。当你处于画布内时，你可以直接在地面上描画符文，这会使符文扩散到整个空间内，并将其描画到你选择的画布内的任意数量生物身上。画布持续 1 分钟。

Frequency once per 10 minutes

You produce four rune-inscribed stones, which whirl in the air once before darting away to the perimeter of a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] centered on your square. While you are within the canvas, you can trace a rune directly into the ground, which causes the rune to expand across the entire space, tracing it onto however many creatures on the canvas you choose. The canvas lasts for 1 minute.

Life Tap.name: 生命分流 Life Tap
Life Tap.description:
敌人的生命力任由你攫取。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.YVfodQvT43gaxoC1] 墓穴法术。

The life force of your enemies is yours to take. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.YVfodQvT43gaxoC1] grave spell.

Desperate Surge.name: 绝望奋迅 Desperate Surge
Desperate Surge.description:
频率 每 10 分钟一次，或直到重新充能（见后文）

处于生死关头的人能够激发出难以置信的力量。凭借你对此类境况的精通掌握，你可以在需要时引出这股力量。你可以使用法术攻击掷骰来代替运动检定，对一名生物尝试 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}、或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}。你可以通过对触及范围内的一具残骸进行徒手打击以吸收其力量，从而使绝望奋迅重新充能；该打击自动命中、摧毁该残骸，并令此能力重新充能。

Frequency once per 10 minutes or until recharged (see text)

People in life-or-death situations can summon up impossible strength. With your mastery of such subjects, you can induce this strength when needed. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} a creature using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check. You can recharge Desperate Surge by making an unarmed Strike against a thrall in reach to absorb its strength, which automatically hits, destroys the thrall, and recharges the ability.

Bone Speaker.name: 解读骨相 Bone Speaker
Bone Speaker.description:
你可以通过一名活体生物体内或体表的骨骼组织来使用不死学识对其进行 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Recall Knowledge]{Recall Knowledge}。若你如此做，你仅能获得该生物生理学相关的信息——你无法得知任何关于后天习得或物品赋予的能力的信息。此外，你可以使用不死学识代替医疗技能对一具包含骨骼的死去生物的尸体进行法医检验。

You can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Recall Knowledge]{Recall Knowledge} on living creatures with an internal or external skeleton using Undead Lore. If you do, you can learn only information pertaining to the biology of a creature—you cannot learn information about any learned abilities or abilities granted by items. Additionally, you can perform a forensic examination on a corpse using Undead Lore instead of Medicine if the corpse came from a creature with a skeleton.

Runic Tattoo.name: 符文刺青 Runic Tattoo
Runic Tattoo.description:
你在自己的肉体上绘制你最喜欢的符文，你知道你永远都离不开它。选择一个你掌握的符文，将其作为刺青应用在你身上。这个符文会一直蚀刻在你的身体上，并且不计入你蚀刻符文的上限。你可以像激发其他符文一样激发这个符文，但一旦激发，符文就会明显消散，并在下一次每日准备之前耗尽能量。

你可以用魔法改变你的符文刺青，用一周的休整期将其更改为你所掌握的其他符文（或完全移除）。

Drawing your favorite rune in your flesh, you know you'll never be without it. Choose one rune you know, which you apply as a tattoo to your body. The rune is always etched on your body and doesn't count toward your maximum limit of etched runes. You can invoke this rune like any of your other runes, but once invoked, the rune fades significantly and is drained of power until your next daily preparations.

You can magically alter your runic tattoo to change it to another rune you know (or remove it altogether) with a week of downtime.

Overloaded Ammunition.name: 过载弹药 Overloaded Ammunition
Overloaded Ammunition.description:
你能将力量灌注于箭矢或弹石之中，使其化为爆炸性弹药。在你的每日准备期间，你可以在 2 件弹药上刻下蕴含力量的铭文，将其转化为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rKknk8odXDBpON5l]。该爆炸弹药的 DC 等同于你的职业 DC。这些灌注的力量并不稳定，若到下一次每日准备时仍未使用，弹药会自行燃烧成灰，因此该弹药出售时不具备任何价值。

在 14 级时，你改为创造 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.g27kK39Nzqphl1Tb]。

You can bind power into arrows or sling stones to transform them into explosive missiles. During your daily preparations, you can lay power-containing inscriptions upon 2 pieces of ammunition to transform them into @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rKknk8odXDBpON5l]. The DC of the explosive ammunition is equal to your class DC. The bindings on the power are unstable and the ammunition burns itself to ash by your next daily preparations if not used, and so the ammunition has no value if sold.

At 14th level, you create @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.g27kK39Nzqphl1Tb] instead.

Muscle Barrier.name: 肌腱之壁 Muscle Barrier
Muscle Barrier.description:
你创造出一层格外厚实的肌肉以保护你的目标。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.OKHzvgfvdR3qqiqR] 墓穴法术。

You create an extra-thick layer of muscle to protect your target. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.OKHzvgfvdR3qqiqR] grave spell.

Tracing Trance.name: 出神描画 Tracing Trance
Tracing Trance.description:
触发 你的回合开始。

你的双手不由自主地舞动，仿佛出于最纯粹的本能般描绘符文。你陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} 直到你的回合结束，并且只能使用额外动作进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace Runes}，包括在使用双动作版本的描画符文时提供 1 个动作。由于沉浸在创造过程中，本回合你不能使用任何激发动作。

Trigger Your turn begins.

Your hands flow unbidden, tracing runes as if by purest instinct. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace Runes}, including to supply 1 action if using the 2-action version of Trace Rune. Absorbed in the act of creation, you can't use any invocation actions this turn.

Dance of Bloody Ink.name: 血墨之舞 Dance of Bloody Ink
Dance of Bloody Ink.description:
当你挥舞武器时，你的武器就是你的画笔，伤口会在目标的肉体上形成有力量的文字。你激发一个你正在持用的武器上的符文，然后用武器打击。如果命中，你可以进行快步，用同一把武器再次进行打击。如果第二次打击命中，你在打击目标身上描画一个符文。这两次打击都会计入多重攻击减值，但在你完成所有攻击之前减值不会增加。

As you lash out, your weapon is your brush, wounds forming words of power in your target's flesh. You Invoke a Rune on a melee weapon you are wielding and Strike with the weapon. On a hit, you can Step and Strike again with the same weapon. If the second Strike hits, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike. Both attacks counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

Ectoplasmic Aura.name: 魂能灵光 Ectoplasmic Aura
Ectoplasmic Aura.description:
你与 30 尺内的所有盟友在 AC 上获得 +1 环境加值，因为你们与敌人之间的空气被灵质所充盈。此外，任何在此灵光内结束回合的敌人必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] 豁免。若失败，其在下个回合开始之前无法使用反应。

注：派索并未为此能力提供 DC，此处使用了你的职业 DC 与法术 DC 中较高的一个。

You and all allies within 30 feet gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC as the air between them and their enemies thickens with ectoplasm. Additionally, any enemy that ends its turn in this aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] saving throw. On a failure, it can't use reactions until the start of its next turn.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. Here we have used the better of your class or spell DC.

Living Graveyard.name: 活体坟场 Living Graveyard
Living Graveyard.description:
你召唤出一片庞大的、可移动的坟场。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.SK8vQklaSQGd5DXw] 墓穴法术。

You conjure forth a massive, animated graveyard. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.SK8vQklaSQGd5DXw] grave spell.

Backup Runic Enhancement.name: 备用符文强化 Backup Runic Enhancement
Backup Runic Enhancement.description:
虽然你不是施法者，但你掌握了最基本的符文魔法知识。你能够以内在法术的形式随意施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W] 戏法。每天一次，你能够以内在法术的形式选择施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT] 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]。这些法术的环级等同于你等级的一半，向上取整，根源可以是与你至少为受训的技能相关的任意根源。

While you are not a spellcaster, you have a working knowledge of the most fundamental of runic magic. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W] cantrip as an innate spell at will. Once per day, you can cast your choice of either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ] as an innate spell. The rank of these spells is equal to half your level, rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least trained in the related skill.

Invisible Ink.name: 隐形墨水 Invisible Ink
Invisible Ink.description:
符文绘制完成后，它会闪烁一次，然后消失，只留下最明显的标记。你可以使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object} 动作，将符文藏匿在你所应用符文的物品或生物上；GM 掷骰手艺检定而非隐秘检定。

After your rune is drawn, it flares once and then fades, leaving only the barest mark. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object} action with any of your applied runes to hide the rune on the object or creature to whom you have applied it; the GM rolls a Crafting check instead of Stealth.

Living Lexicon.name: 活字典 Living Lexicon
Living Lexicon.description:
你的符文知识无穷无尽。你添加一个额外符文到你的符文库中。 20级

Your knowledge of runes knows no bounds. You gain an additional rune in your runic repertoire.

Ghostly Resonance.name: 幽魂共鸣 Ghostly Resonance
Ghostly Resonance.description:
你的符文不仅能从灵界汲取力量，还能让最平凡的物品伤害灵体生物。你可以选择让任何携带有你的神术或异能符文的生物或物品在带有你的符文期间获得 ghost touch 符文的增益。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.aPtwKbOPYEAYrVa4]{Effect: Ghostly Resonance}

Your runes can not only draw power from the world of the spirits, but they can let even the most mundane objects harm spiritual beings as well. You can choose to grant any creature or item bearing one of your divine or occult runes the benefits of a ghost touch rune for as long as they are bearing your rune.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.aPtwKbOPYEAYrVa4]{Effect: Ghostly Resonance}

Runic Reprisal.name: 符文报复 Runic Reprisal
Runic Reprisal.description:
当你举起盾牌时，你会在盾牌上埋下一个符文陷阱，在敌人武器碰撞时引爆。当你使用防御凿刻时，你可以在盾牌上描画一个伤害性符文，即使该符文通常无法应用到盾牌上。被描画的符文不会产生正常效果，而是会逐渐消失在盾牌上。如果你使用盾牌对一个相邻目标进行盾牌格挡，你可以将激发符文作为反应动作的一部分，使符文向外引爆并对攻击生物施加其激发效果。

When you raise your shield, you bury a runic trap into it, to be set off by the clash of an enemy weapon. When you use Fortifying Knock, you can trace a damaging rune on your shield, even if it could not normally be applied to a shield. The traced rune doesn't have its normal effect, instead fading into your shield. If you Shield Block with the shield against an adjacent target, you can Invoke the Rune as part of the reaction, causing the rune to detonate outwards and apply its invocation effect to the attacking creature.

Distant Invocation.name: 极远激发 Distant Invocation
Distant Invocation.description:
你与符文的联系可以延伸到更远的距离。你的任何激发能力的射程都会增加30尺（通常从 30尺增加到60尺）。

Your connection to your runes stretches over even greater distances. You add 30 feet to the range of any of your invocation abilities (typically increasing the range from 30 to 60 feet).

Return Unto Runes.name: 封入符文 Return Unto Runes
Return Unto Runes.description:
触发 你成为一个远程法术攻击的目标。

需求 你有一只空手或持有一件工匠工具包。

你尝试将袭来的法术解构为单独的魔法组件，并将其临时储存为符文。你在对抗触发攻击时AC上获得+4环境加值。如果攻击未命中，法术会变回原始形态被封印在符文中，并漂浮在你空手上或环绕在工匠工具上。直到你的下个回合结束，你可以如常描画此符文到一个生物身上。当符文被激发时，它会产生你解构的法术的效果，就像原本施法者对目标施放了法术一样。符文只影响它所作用的生物，即使原来的法术通常可以影响更多的目标。

Trigger You are targeted by a ranged spell attack.

Requirements You have a hand free or are holding an artisan's toolkit.

You attempt to deconstruct an incoming spell into its individual magical components, storing them temporarily as a rune. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the spell is returned to its original form sealed in a rune, which floats around your free hand or around your artisan's tools. Until the end of your next turn, you can Trace this Rune onto a creature as normal. When the rune is invoked, it has the effects of the spell you deconstructed, as if the original caster had cast it on the target. The rune affects only the creature it was applied to, even if the original spell could usually affect a greater number of targets.

Conglomerate of Limbs.name: 残肢聚合 Conglomerate of Limbs
Conglomerate of Limbs.description:
你召唤出一具由血肉肢体堆叠而成的笨重巨物。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.OOmk0XI3lzhn42JT] 墓穴法术。

You call forth a lumbering mass of fleshy limbs. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.OOmk0XI3lzhn42JT] grave spell.

Fortifying Knock.name: 防御凿刻 Fortifying Knock
Fortifying Knock.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 你正持用一面盾牌。

盾牌是你艺术创作的天然画布。只需一次动作，你就能 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} 并在盾牌上 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune}。

Frequency once per round

Requirements You are wielding a shield.

Your shield is a natural canvas for your art. in one motion, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.wamCImlN6xwUHzyk]{Trace a Rune} on your shield.

Bind Heroic Spirit.name: 束缚英魂 Bind Heroic Spirit
Bind Heroic Spirit.description:
你将一名亡故英雄的魂灵暂时束缚于自身之中，获得他们的部分才能。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.rJ4dm9Vw7KJUKcoE] 墓穴法术。

You temporarily bind the spirit of a dead hero into you, gaining some of their talent. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.rJ4dm9Vw7KJUKcoE] grave spell.

Mortem Ultimatum.name: 尸骸终解 Mortem Ultimatum
Mortem Ultimatum.description:
你已发现生与死的至深奥秘。你获得一个额外的 10 环法术位。

You have discovered the greatest secrets of life and death. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

Chain of Words.name: 符字之链 Chain of Words
Chain of Words.description:
频率 每 10 分钟一次

你能看到你的作品之间的魔法细线。你可以利用这种联系，将力量从一个符文转移到另一个符文。对 60 尺内两个不同的符文携带者使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.ozrq9hAuigjzwe9C]{Invoke Runes}。除了符文的正常效果外，一条发光的文字链会在他们之间流动，对连线中的所有生物造成 @Damage[((floor(@actor.level/2))d6)[force]|options:area-damage] 伤害，但不会对符文携带者造成伤害。生物可以尝试一次 @Check[reflex|against:runesmith|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免；如果大失败，他们会因被符文封印移动而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}，直到你的下个回合结束或直到他们 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}。逃脱的 DC 为你的职业 DC。

在 12 级，以及之后的每两级，伤害提升 1d6。

Frequency once per 10 minutes

You see the thin lines of magic between your creations. You can exploit that connection with a small shift of power traveling from one rune to another. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.ozrq9hAuigjzwe9C]{Invoke Runes} on two different rune-bearers within 60 feet. In addition to the runes' normal effects, a chain of glowing script flows between them, dealing @Damage[((floor(@actor.level/2))d6)[force]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the line, but not the rune-bearers. Creatures can attempt a @Check[reflex|against:runesmith|basic|options:area-effect] saving throw; on a critical failure, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} as the runes seal their movements until the end of your next turn or until they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. The DC to escape is your class DC.

At 12th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

Annihilating Composite Invocation.name: 湮灭复合激发 Annihilating Composite Invocation
Annihilating Composite Invocation.description:
频率 每小时一次

每种根源的魔法都掌管着构成万物的四种精粹中的两种，因此同时激发每种根源魔法中的符文，你就能从魔法的四个角落解开任何谜团。你激发单个生物身上由你选择的四个符文，每个符文都必须来自不同的魔法根源。除了符文的正常效果外，目标还必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|against:runesmith|basic] 豁免，否则就会受到 @Damage[10d4[force]] 伤害，因为破坏性的魔法谐波会在他们体内发生冲突。如果受到这种伤害或任何符文的伤害而导致生命值降低到 0，那么该生物的身体会被撕裂成发光的文字，这些文字会对该生物进行最详细的描述，不会留下任何残骸，但随着文字的消逝，会不造成损伤地留下他的装备。

注：派索并未指明此能力消耗多少动作，因此我们使用 2 个动作以与所有非 4 环激发保持一致。

Frequency once per hour

Each tradition of magic holds sway over two of the four essences that make up all of creation, and so by invoking runes from each tradition at once, you can pull from the four corners of magic to unravel anything. You invoke four runes of your choice on a single creature, which must be from each tradition of magic. In addition to the runes' normal effects, the target must also succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:runesmith|basic] saving throw or take @Damage[10d4[force]] damage as destructive magical harmonics clash in their body. If reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage or by the damage of any of the runes invoked, the creature's body is torn apart into glowing script that describes the creature to the smallest detail, leaving no remains but leaving their gear unharmed as the letters fade.

Note: Paizo did not specify how many actions this costs, so we used 2 to be in line with all non-4th level invocations

Terrifying Invocation.name: 骇人激发 Terrifying Invocation
Terrifying Invocation.description:
当你念出符文的可怕名字时，你发怒并发出怒吼。你尝试对射程内单个目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}，然后对目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.ozrq9hAuigjzwe9C]{Invoke one Rune}。只要目标在你激发射程内，你就能对目标挫败士气，即便该生物不懂你的语言，你也不会承受减值。

You spit and roar as you pronounce your rune's terrible name. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a single target within range, and then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-actions.Item.ozrq9hAuigjzwe9C]{Invoke one Rune} upon the target. You can Demoralize the target as long as they are within range of your invocation, and you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language.

Lifesense.name: 生命感知 Lifesense
Lifesense.description:
你与生命和死亡力量的连接使你在一瞥之间便能感知生物的生命力量。你获得30尺生命感知作为模糊感官。这一感官令你可以探知距离内的所有活体与不死生物。此外，你知晓30尺内所有活体或不死生物的当前HP和临时生命值。

Your connection to life and death allows you to sense the life force of a creature with a glance. You gain imprecise lifesense with a range of 30 feet. This sense allows you to detect living and undead creatures within range. Additionally, you know the current Hit Points and temporary Hit Points of any living or undead creature you can see within 30 feet.

Perfected Thrall.name: 完化残骸 Perfected Thrall
Perfected Thrall.description:
运用你所积累的关于一切死灵术形式的知识，你创造出完美的残骸。你习得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.kFkhtDYsR9fE0pAr] 专注法术。

Using your accumulated knowledge of all forms of necromancy, you create the perfect thrall. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-spells.Item.kFkhtDYsR9fE0pAr] focus spell.

Vital Conduit.name: 命源导联 Vital Conduit
Vital Conduit.description:
你在皮肤之下添加了一层薄得不可思议的致密肌肉，从而使皮肤变得厚实。你的最大生命值提高你的等级。每当你摧毁一具残骸时，邻接于你的每名敌人都必须以你的法术 DC 通过一次 @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

You thicken your skin by adding an impossibly thin layer of dense muscle directly under the surface. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. Whenever you destroy a thrall, each enemy adjacent to you must succeed a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

prerequisites.value: 血肉魔巫阴森痴迷 flesh magician grim fascination

Bone Burst.name: 白骨崩裂 Bone Burst
Bone Burst.description:
触发 一名邻接于你残骸的生物使用一个操作动作或一个移动动作、进行一次远程攻击，或在使用移动动作时离开了一个方格，且你位于该残骸的 60 尺内。

你摧毁该残骸，使其爆炸成朝触发生物飞射的骨片，造成 @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,18),4,ternary(gte(@actor.level,12),3,2))d10)[piercing]] 伤害，附带一个 @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] 豁免。该伤害在 12 级时提升至 3d10，在 18 级时提升至 4d10。

注：派索并未为此能力提供 DC，此处使用了你的职业 DC 与法术 DC 中较高的一个。

Trigger A creature adjacent to one of your thralls uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using, and you are within 60 feet of the thrall.

You destroy the thrall in an explosion of bone shards directed toward the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,18),4,ternary(gte(@actor.level,12),3,2))d10)[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save. This damage increases to 3d10 at 12th level and to 4d10 at 18th level.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. Here we have used the better of your class or spell DC.

Clashing Composite Invocation.name: 冲突复合激发 Clashing Composite Invocation
Clashing Composite Invocation.description:
频率 每 10 分钟一次

当你激发来自不同魔法根源的符文时，它们截然相反的效果会在破坏性强烈冲突中相互排斥。你激发单个生物身上由你选择的两个符文，两个符文必须是来自对立的魔法根源；一个奥术符文和一个神术符文，或者一个异能符文和一个原能符文。除了符文的正常效果外，目标还必须在破坏性魔法谐波在其体内冲突时尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|against:runesmith] 豁免。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}，但他如果使用一个动作来稳定自身，恶心状态会立即结束。

失败 目标陷入恶心 1。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

Frequency once per 10 minutes

As you invoke runes from disparate traditions of magic, their diametrically opposed effects repel each other in a destructive backlash. You invoke two runes of your choice on a single creature, which must be from opposed traditions of magic; either 1 arcane and 1 divine rune, or 1 occult and 1 primal rune. in addition to the runes' normal effects, the target must also attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:runesmith] saving throw as destructive magical harmonics clash in their body.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, but if they take an action to steady themself, the sickened condition ends immediately.

Failure The target is sickened 1.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Become as Spirit.name: 化身魂灵 Become as Spirit
Become as Spirit.description:
你可以穿过非自愿生物所占据的空间，视同你穿过困难地形。此外，你忽视自然困难地形，并且在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} 检定上获得 +2 环境加值。每当你摧毁一具残骸时，你获得对所有伤害的抗力（除了力场、幽冥触击、精魂或命能伤害），等同于你等级的一半，持续 1 轮。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.hr6kXQdjnl57Js1Z]{Effect: Become as Spirit}

You can move through unwilling creature's spaces as though they were difficult terrain. Additionally, you ignore natural difficult terrain and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} checks. Whenever you destroy a thrall, you gain resistance to all damage (except force, ghost touch, spirit, or vitality) equal to half your level for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.hr6kXQdjnl57Js1Z]{Effect: Become as Spirit}
